articles.summary: Last week, we celebrated National First Responders Day, where we honored the extraordinary service, bravery, and dedication of those who keep our communities safe. First responders run toward emergencies with an unwavering commitment to public safety. To all first responders: thank you for your service and your partnership. Engaging Early and Often At Aurora, our commitment to safety extends to everyone on the road, and that explicitly includes prioritizing first responders. We believe that...
articles.title: Helping our Heroes: How the Aurora Driver Puts First Responders First
